name: What is the process for a whole home remodel from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a whole home remodel from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our whole home remodel process typically begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and goals. This is followed by detailed design and planning, including architectural drawings and material selections. Next, we manage the permitting process. Construction phases involve demolition, framing, rough-ins for plumbing and electrical, insulation, drywall, and finally, finish work such as flooring, cabinetry, and painting. The project concludes with a final walkthrough and handover, ensuring your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, detailed design and planning, permitting, demolition, structural work, rough-ins, finishes, and a final walkthrough. We manage each phase for a smooth transition.
